info.name: Order Service
info.description:
Friend on Campus Order API through the gateway, following the errand lifecycle end to end.

Before running: set requesterEmail/requesterPassword, courierEmail/courierPassword and adminEmail/adminPassword (three different ACTIVE accounts; the requester needs 10 available credits - a new account's allocation - and the admin account must have the Admin role and may switch to Courier). Run folders in order (Collection Runner, or one request at a time). Tokens are filled in by the sign-in requests.

Never commit real passwords or tokens: put them in a local environment, or clear the variables before exporting.

exec: // A pickup deadline two hours from now, so every create/edit sends a future deadline.

item.name: 0. Setup
item.description: Run first. Signs in both people and picks two Supplier locations. Fill in the four account variables (Variables tab) before running; keep real passwords in your local environment, not in the exported file.

request.description: Signs in through the gateway and stores the token. Tokens stay in collection variables: never export or commit them.
Each session carries exactly one role; the backend authorises every action by it.
Creates the one-time 10-credit allocation if needed (idempotent) and records the balance.

exec: pm.test('at least 10 credits available (errands A = 7 and B = 3)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().availableBalance).to.be.at.least(10));

item.name: Admin's account: a COURIER session (third person for the race)

request.description: Lets the admin account act as a second courier for the race-loser request in folder 2.
Order never calls Supplier: the client picks locations here and sends both the ID and the name, which Order stores as a snapshot.

else { pm.collectionVariables.set('tries', 0); pm.test('courier +7 (full reward settled)', () => pm.expect(got).to.eql(7)); }
